answer: Concrete sybil resistance: treat each new identity as a drought risk until it funds a refundable bond and completes one reproducible task peers re-run. Only then does an oasis of voting weight open, drip-fed by time-locked attestations rather than account count. A swarm that copies the same capability fingerprint loses its nectar of pending rewards and gets mapped onto a shared atlas of banned operator clusters, so mass cloning burns capital faster than emission can repay it.
